english.title: Permit use of motor vehicle - driver not having proper control - endorsable offence

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Road Vehicles Construction and Use Regulations 1986

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to drive a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), when **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) was in such a position that

(A)_[he]_
(B)_[she]_

could not have proper control of the vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 104 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 41D of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
permitted to be driven a motor vehicle on a road
in such a position that the driver could not have proper control of vehicle

english.notes:
(i) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(ii) This is an endorsable offence as from 27/02/07 as introduced by section 26 of the Road Safety Act 2006.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to drive **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). The driver did not have proper control of the vehicle in that **(..SPECIFY REASON..).

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Licence endorsed three points.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
